//: MONOREPO DEV HARNESS - NOT PART OF THIS TEMPLATE. This file is deliberately absent from frontx-template.json's ownershipBoundaries, so `frontx add` never copies it into a seeded project and this template claims ownership of no root package.json anywhere. The MFE packages below pin their @gears-frontx dependencies to exact published versions, which is what a seeded project installs. Inside THIS repo (templates only, no packages/api|gts-plugin|mfes on disk) those pins always resolve to the registry - the ecosystem packages live in gears-frontx and are consumed exactly as published, the same as a seeded project would. The overrides here redirect only the pins this repo CAN offer a local source for: template-shell/packages/* (react, auth, framework, i18n, state, unit-producer) so an edit there is visible to an MFE's own direct imports without a publish round-trip. @gears-frontx/api, @gears-frontx/gts-plugin and @gears-frontx/mfes have no such override - their sources live in gears-frontx, not here - so edits to them reach this harness only after a real publish and a pin bump (`policy:template-pin-drift`), same as any other consumer. @gears-frontx/ui-kit is deliberately NOT overridden either, for the same reason plus one of its own: it is a published component library an MFE consumes, not a layer the MFE is developed against, so leaving it on its exact pin means the scaffold resolves exactly what a seeded project resolves - the whole point of depending on the kit rather than vendoring it. Because they redirect rather than re-declare, the installed versions still satisfy the pins and `npm ls` stays clean. Bootstrap order: template-shell as a whole (`npm run build`, which builds its subpackages in dependency order) must be built before `npm install` here picks up its dist. Call template-shell's own `build` rather than its `build:packages` by hand; that script is order-sensitive. See this package's README for the exact sequence. Keep this file free of version numbers: every entry below is a path or a glob, so the pins remain the single place a version is written down. Three overrides are unrelated to all of the above and are the three versions written here. One: "nwsapi": "2.2.28" pins jsdom's transitive CSS-matching engine past 2.2.26 and 2.2.27, which hang user-event's pointer-events checks 25-30 s per click (the cause is not escaped selectors in the studio sheet) - see template-shell/package.json's matching "//" entry. Carried here because this harness shares the same jsdom dependency chain. The other, "reselect": "5.2.0", dedupes reselect for the shared-unit build's version check: recharts pins it exactly at 5.2.0 while @reduxjs/toolkit and @base-ui/utils accept that version, so one copy satisfies every dependent and _blank-mfe/demo-mfe no longer reach two versions from their shared closure - see template-shell/package.json's matching "//" entry. The third, "@tanstack/store": "0.11.2", dedupes @tanstack/store for the same version check: @tanstack/react-store 0.11.1 (reached through @gears-frontx/ui-kit's @tanstack/react-table) pins it exactly at 0.11.1 while @tanstack/react-store 0.11.2 (reached through @tanstack/react-router) pins 0.11.2, so without the override the shared closure reaches two versions - see template-shell/package.json's matching "//" entry.
